| Chapter Title | Topic | Description of Algorithm | First Reference |

|               | Three-dimensional scatterplot | Using Python to generate a three-dimensional plot of a multiple regression model | Machine Learning in Regression Analysis |

elements.summary: This table summarizes various Python algorithms covered in the textbook, listing their chapter titles, topics, descriptions, and first references for further study. It includes algorithms related to regression, decision trees, random forests, naïve Bayes, and deep learning techniques such as perceptrons, neural networks, and recurrent neural networks.
